mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of broader economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen by >0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in late-cycle expansion regimes.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict SPX returns with a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized), rising inflation erodes real corporate profits and triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm payroll growth below 0.1% signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail sales growth (RSAFS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS growth rate exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production growth below 0.2% signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth rate is below 0.2%.
